Simple 5-Step Process

It’s Easy to Get Started

We handle everything from initial concept to post-party cleanup so you can be a guest at your own event.

01

Tell Us Your Vision

Share your event date, venue location, theme ideas, or inspiration photos via our quote tool.

→
02

Receive Custom Design & Quote

Kam will craft a bespoke styling proposal with exact color palettes and transparent pricing.

→
03

Approve & Secure Date

Confirm your design details and place a small deposit to hold your setup date on our calendar.

→
04

Professional Installation

On event day, Sandeep & Kam deliver, assemble props, inflate double-stuffed balloons & detail vinyl.

→
05

Enjoy Your Event!

Walk into your beautifully transformed venue, take photos with guests, and enjoy a stress-free day.

The Hearts Behind The Brand

Meet the Names & Hearts Behind Balloon Galaxy

A family-founded business born out of passion, precision, and a love for creating beautiful memories.

Founder & Creative Lead

Kam

K

A qualified accountant by profession, Kam founded Balloon Galaxy in October 2022. She made the bold decision to leave her full-time corporate accounting job to spend more time with her two boys and follow her passion for balloon styling. Bringing financial precision and artistic passion together, Kam is your main point of contact from your initial quote to final installation.

Hands-On Role In Every Event:

  • Client Consultation & Quotes
  • Color Palette Curation
  • Balloon Ordering & Quality Testing
  • Vinyl Signage Prep
  • Inflation & Assembly
"Leaving corporate accounting to build Balloon Galaxy allowed me to cherish moments with my boys while doing what I truly love—bringing joy and beauty to families across the West Midlands."
Setup Specialist & Prop Craftsman

Sandeep

S

Sandeep is the master behind event day logistics and prop perfection. From custom painting backdrop boards in exact hex colors to assembling heavy-duty frame structures, Sandeep ensures every physical element is flawless before guests arrive.

Hands-On Role In Every Event:

  • Prop Painting & Preparation
  • Structural Safety & Base Weighting
  • On-Site Venue Logistics
  • Event Breakdown & Collection
"Every celebration deserves a clean, sturdy, picture-perfect backdrop. Seeing client reactions when we finish a setup makes all the hard work worthwhile."
